name: ETL Google Play Store Reviews to MySQL
steps:
**Google Play Store Reviews to MySQL**

1.  From the DataSources section select Google Play Store Reviews as the data source.
2.  Select your added MySQL data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your Google Play Store account, similar to the process described in this [Documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/google-play-store-reviews/setup.html) page.
4.  Click on [\+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/google-play-store-reviews/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
